chapter: Raymond Scott, Kirby and postwar bands
title: Kirby recordings and a brief spell with Jimmy Dorsey
summary: Leeman made only a couple of Muzak sides with Kirby that carry another drummer's credit, then spent three or four months with Jimmy Dorsey.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: And I did a few of those things. The only recording I did at the time with John Kirby was I did a couple of Musak things and I've never heard them. I saw one listed that I made once, and it didn't have my name on it. Who was the drummer ... a little short fellow --

He got credit for one of those Muzak things. Because when Kirby went back, he played against Duke Ellington, and I had gone home - that's when I went home. That gig was over, and I went for a very short time on the road with Jimmy Dorsey, which was a bad experience, because he was sick and I just mentioned that I went with Jimmy Dorsey three or four months.
And then around -- what year did you go into --
